30559-eighth-reader.title: Eighth Reader
30559-eighth-reader.creator: Unknown
30559-eighth-reader.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. ifficult for comprehension and yet embracing various styles of literary workmanship and illustrating the different forms of English composition. The contents of this volume have been chosen and arranged to supply--or, where not supplying, to suggest--the materials for this kind of practice.

36420-between-sun-and-sand-a-tale-of-an-.title: Between Sun And Sand A Tale Of An African Desert
36420-between-sun-and-sand-a-tale-of-an-.creator: William Charles Scully
36420-between-sun-and-sand-a-tale-of-an-.description: A book by William Charles Scully. This region is known as Bushmanland--the name having reference to its former inhabitants who, proving themselves "unfit," were abolished from the face of the earth. Bushmanland is at present intermittently inhabited by a nomadic population of Europeans of Dutch descent, who are known as "Trek-Boers."  To "trek" means, literally, to "pull," but its colloquial significance is--to move about from place to place.

arxiv-2106-05293.title: The RSD Sorting Hat: Unmixing Radial Scales in Projection
arxiv-2106-05293.creator: Peter L. Taylor, Katarina Markovič, Alkistis Pourtsidou, Eric Huff
arxiv-2106-05293.description: Abstract Future data sets will enable cross-correlations between redshift space distortions (RSD) and weak lensing (WL). While photometric lensing and clustering cross-correlations have provided some of the tightest cosmological constraints to date, it is not well understood how to optimally perform similar RSD/WL joint analyses in a lossless way.

arxiv-2208-11428.title: Automatic music mixing with deep learning and out-of-domain data
arxiv-2208-11428.description: Abstract Music mixing traditionally involves recording instruments in the form of clean, individual tracks and blending them into a final mixture using audio effects and expert knowledge (e.g., a mixing engineer). The automation of music production tasks has become an emerging field in recent years, where rule-based methods and machine learning approaches have been explored.

arxiv-2211-15134.title: Evidence of a new shell closed nucleus governing slow quasi-fission
arxiv-2211-15134.creator: A. Pal 1, S. Santra 1,2, A. Kundu 1, D. Chattopadhyay 1, P.C. Rout 1,2, Ramandeep Gandhi 1,2, P. N. Patil 3, R. Tripathi 2,4, B. J. Roy 1,2, Y. Sawant 1, T.N. Nag 2,4, Abhijit Baishya 1,2, T. Santhosh 1,2, P.K. Rath 5, N. Deshmukh 6
arxiv-2211-15134.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by A. Pal 1, S. Santra 1,2, A. Kundu 1, D. Chattopadhyay 1, P.C. Rout 1,2, Ramandeep Gandhi 1,2, P. N. Patil 3, R. Tripathi 2,4, B. J. Roy 1,2, Y. Sawant 1, T.N. Nag 2,4, Abhijit Baishya 1,2, T. Santhosh 1,2, P.K. Rath 5, N. Deshmukh 6. Mass distributions of fission fragments arising from the slow quasi-fission process have been derived by comparing the measured distributions with the theoretical distributions based on compound nuclear fission model for several reactions.

arxiv-2303-14560.title: The Convergence Rate of Vanishing Viscosity Approximations for Mean Field Games
arxiv-2303-14560.creator: Wenpin Tang, Yuming Paul Zhang
arxiv-2303-14560.description: Abstract . Motivated by numerical challenges in first-order mean field games (MFGs) and the weak noise theory for the Kardar–Parisi–Zhang equation, we consider the problem of vanishing viscosity approximations for MFGs. We provide the first results on the convergence rate to the vanishing viscosity limit in mean field games, with a focus on the dimension dependence of the rate exponent.

arxiv-2405-06504.title: Rotational transitions induced by collisions of HD + ions with low energy electrons
arxiv-2405-06504.creator: O. Motapon 1,2, N. Pop 3, F. Argoubi 4, J. Zs Mezei 2,5,6, M. D. Epée Epée 1, A. Faure 7, M. Telmini 4, J. Tennyson 8, I. F. Schneider 2,5
arxiv-2405-06504.description: Abstract A series of Multichannel Quantum Defect Theory-based computations have been performed, in order to produce the cross sections of rotational transitions (excitations N i + − 2 → N_{i}^{+}-2\rightarrow N i + N_{i}^{+} , de-excitations N i + N_{i}^{+} → \rightarrow N i + − 2 N_{i}^{+}-2 , with N i + = 2 N_{i}^{+}=2 to 10 10 )

arxiv-2405-13146.title: A lightweight PUF-based authentication protocol
arxiv-2405-13146.creator: Yu Zhuang, Gaoxiang Li
arxiv-2405-13146.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Yu Zhuang, Gaoxiang Li. Lightweight authentication is essential for resource-constrained Internet-of-Things (IoT). Implementable with low resource and operable with low power, Physical Unclonable Functions (PUFs) have the potential as hardware primitives for implementing lightweight authentication protocols. The arbiter PUF (APUF) is probably the most lightweight strong PUF capable of generating exponentially many challenge-response pairs (CRPs), a desirable property for authentication protocols, but APUF is severely weak against modeling attacks.

arxiv-2406-04840.title: TraceableSpeech: Towards Proactively Traceable Text-to-Speech with Watermarking
arxiv-2406-04840.creator: Junzuo Zhou, Jiangyan Yi, Tao Wang, Jianhua Tao, Ye Bai, Chu Yuan Zhang, Yong Ren, Zhengqi Wen
arxiv-2406-04840.description: Abstract Various threats posed by the progress in text-to-speech (TTS) have prompted the need to reliably trace synthesized speech. However, contemporary approaches to this task involve adding watermarks to the audio separately after generation, a process that hurts both speech quality and watermark imperceptibility. In addition, these approaches are limited in robustness and flexibility.

arxiv-2502-08791.title: VL-Explore : Zero-shot Vision-Language Exploration and Target Discovery by Mobile Robots
arxiv-2502-08791.creator: Yuxuan Zhang, Adnan Abdullah, Sanjeev J. Koppal, Md Jahidul Islam, ⋆ Equal Contribution
arxiv-2502-08791.description: Abstract Vision-language navigation (VLN) has emerged as a promising paradigm, enabling mobile robots to perform zero-shot inference and execute tasks without specific pre-programming. However, current systems often separate map exploration and path planning, with exploration relying on inefficient algorithms due to limited (partially observed) environmental information.

arxiv-2507-03074.title: Differentiable Halo Mass Prediction and the Cosmology-Dependence of Halo Mass Functions
arxiv-2507-03074.creator: Jim Buisman 1,⋆, Florian List 1, Oliver Hahn 1,2
arxiv-2507-03074.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Jim Buisman 1,⋆, Florian List 1, Oliver Hahn 1,2. Modern cosmological inference increasingly relies on differentiable models to enable efficient, gradient-based parameter estimation and uncertainty quantification. Here, we present a novel approach for predicting the abundance of dark matter haloes and their cosmology dependence using a differentiable, field-level neural network (NN) model, and study how well the cosmology dependence is captured by common parametrisations of the halo mass function (HMF), and by our NN-based approach.

arxiv-2508-06126.title: IOCC: Aligning Semantic and Cluster Centers for Few-shot Short Text Clustering
arxiv-2508-06126.creator: Jixuan Yin Zhihao Yao Wenshuai Huo Xinmiao Yu Xiaocheng Feng Bo Li
arxiv-2508-06126.description: Abstract In clustering tasks, it is essential to structure the feature space into clear, well-separated distributions. However, because short text representations have limited expressiveness, conventional methods struggle to identify cluster centers that truly capture each category’s underlying semantics, causing the representations to be optimized in suboptimal directions.

arxiv-2511-05767.title: Stokes microcombs in silicon nitride microresonators
arxiv-2511-05767.creator: Artem E. Shitikov 1, Alina N. Golodukhina 1,2, Nikita Yu. Dmitriev 1, Darya M. Sokol 1,3, Valery E. Lobanov 1, Igor A. Bilenko 1,2, Dmitry A. Chermoshentsev 1,3
arxiv-2511-05767.description: Abstract Silicon nitride microresonators have become an ubiquitous platform for cutting-edge photonics applications. Improvement in silicon nitride fabrication techniques, providing ultra-high quality-factor values up to 10 7 10^{7} , has opened up new possibilities for nonlinear effects realizations in such structures.

arxiv-2602-07577.title: Particle Mechanics from Local Energy Conservation
arxiv-2602-07577.creator: Thomas Oikonomou
arxiv-2602-07577.description: Abstract We develop a formulation of particle mechanics in which the functional relation between force and kinetic energy is derived directly from local conservation mechanical energy E E , rather than postulated through Newton’s second law or a variational principle.

pmc-10628011.title: Challenges in the Evaluation of Emerging Highly Specialised Technologies: Is There a Role for Living HTA?
pmc-10628011.creator: Tracy Merlin, Jackie Street, Drew Carter, Hossein Haji Ali Afzali
pmc-10628011.description: There is currently deep uncertainty about the clinical benefits and cost effectiveness of highly specialised technologies (HSTs), like gene and cell therapies. These treatments are novel, typically have high upfront costs, the patient populations are small and heterogenous, there is minimal information on their long-term safety and effectiveness, and data are limited and often of poor quality.

pmc-11008784.title: Automated news in practice: a cross-national exploratory study
pmc-11008784.creator: Samuel Danzon-Chambaud, Nathalie Pignard-Cheynel, Andrew Robotham, Julian Maitra, Nathalie Pignard-Cheynel, Andrew Robotham, Samuel Danzon-Chambaud, Julian Maitra, Samuel Danzon-Chambaud, Nathalie Pignard-Cheynel, Andrew Robotham, Samuel Danzon-Chambaud
pmc-11008784.description: BackgroundThis article provides a comprehensive picture of the current state of automated news—understood here as the auto-generation of journalistic text through software and algorithms—as well as to where it is headed. For this, I look at 18 news organisations in Europe, North America and Australia, following a strategic sample inspired by Hallin and Mancini’s (2004) media system typology.

pmc-11282818.title: Immunological factors, important players in the development of asthma
pmc-11282818.creator: Yang Wang, Li Liu
pmc-11282818.description: Asthma is a heterogeneous disease, and its development is the result of a combination of factors, including genetic factors, environmental factors, immune dysfunction and other factors. Its specific mechanism has not yet been fully investigated. With the improvement of disease models, research on the pathogenesis of asthma has made great progress. Immunological disorders play an important role in asthma.

pmc-11386956.title: A three filament mechanistic model of musculotendon force and impedance
pmc-11386956.creator: Matthew Millard, David W Franklin, Walter Herzog, Eric Tytell, Matthew Millard, David Franklin, Walter Herzog
pmc-11386956.description: The force developed by actively lengthened muscle depends on different structures across different scales of lengthening. For small perturbations, the active response of muscle is well captured by a linear-time-invariant (LTI) system: a stiff spring in parallel with a light damper.

pmc-11693319.title: SELF-FUNDED PERSONAL CARE IS COMMON AND COSTLY FOR PEOPLE WITH DEMENTIA ACROSS THE INCOME SPECTRUM
pmc-11693319.creator: Jennifer Reckrey, Karen Shen, Yang Yang
pmc-11693319.description: remain in the community; those without Medicaid coverage or long-term care insurance must self-fund this care (i.e., pay for privately or out-of-pocket). Using data from the Health and Retirement Study (2002-2018), we identified the prevalence and financial burden of self-funded paid care among community-dwelling people ≥65 who received help with ≥1 activity of daily living (n=4666).

pmc-12471893.title: Whole-Genome-Sequencing Analysis of the Pathogen Causing Spotting Disease and Molecular Response in the Strongylocentrotus intermedius
pmc-12471893.creator: Shufeng Li, Fenglin Tian, Yongjie Wang, Haoran Xiao, Zijie Zhou, Lina Cao, Lingshu Han, Junxiao Sun, Chong Zhao, Jun Ding, Cesar Marcial Escobedo-Bonilla
pmc-12471893.description: Sea urchin aquaculture has experienced remarkable growth in recent years. However, this growth has been accompanied by increased disease prevalence. Notably, spotting disease has particularly severe impacts. In this study, we isolated the pathogen HZ-3-2 from 10 sea urchins with spotting disease, and it was identified as Vibrio splendidus through morphological observations, 16S rDNA sequencing, and whole-genome sequencing.

pmc-12613451.title: Association of body roundness index with risk of all-cause, cardiovascular disease-cause, and cancer-cause mortality: the role of biological age acceleration
pmc-12613451.creator: Pan Ke, Zuxun Lu, Xiaobin Wu, Deliang Lv, Minzhi Xu, Dongsheng Di, Dankang Li, Guangwen Gong, Xiaoxv Yin, Zhiguang Zhao
pmc-12613451.description: ObjectiveThis study aims to explore the association of BRI with all-cause, cardiovascular disease (CVD)-cause, and cancer-cause mortality risk, and the role of biological age acceleration (BAA) in mediating these associations.MethodsWe included 305,406 participants in the UK biobank. BRI was calculated based on waist circumference (WC) and height. BAA was divided into klemera-doubal method biological age acceleration (KDM-BA) and PhenoAge acceleration.

pmc-12614263.title: Cefiderocol and Moxifloxacin Have Additive and Synergistic Activity Against Pseudomonas aeruginosa Including an Isolate of the 2023 Keratitis Outbreak
pmc-12614263.creator: Eric G. Romanowski, Brennan M. Schilling, Emily K. Young, Sonya M. Mumper, Michael E. Zegans, Robert M. Q. Shanks
pmc-12614263.description: PurposeThe 2023 outbreak of Pseudomonas aeruginosa keratitis linked to contaminated artificial tears highlighted the need for new treatments targeting ocular infections caused by multi-drug-resistant and extensively drug-resistant bacteria. This study evaluated the in vitro efficacy and potential synergy of cefiderocol and moxifloxacin against P. aeruginosa keratitis isolates.

pmc-13173798.title: Collective exerkines mediate physical activity mitigating new-onset heart failure risk in older adults with prediabetes or diabetes: a community-based longitudinal cohort study
pmc-13173798.creator: Weike Liu, Luxiang Shang, Peilin Li, Yanli Yao, Haipeng Yin, Hua Zhang, Zhendong Liu, Yuqi Guo
pmc-13173798.description: BackgroundEvidence regarding how collective exerkines mediate the association between physical activity (PA) and heart failure (HF) risk in older adults with prediabetes and diabetes remains limited.MethodsThis prospective cohort study enrolled 5,886 older adults with prediabetes or diabetes from community dwellings in Shandong, China, between 2008 and 2011.

pmc-13253933.title: Mindfulness-based intervention alters nonlinear heart rate variability in a pilot study
pmc-13253933.creator: Yu Gao, Liat Zitron, Serena Guo
pmc-13253933.description: Mindfulness-based interventions (MBIs) have been consistently associated with reductions in perceived stress and anxiety. One proposed mechanism underlying these effects involves a shift toward parasympathetic dominance during stress exposure, facilitating enhanced emotion regulation and physiological adaptability; however, empirical evidence on this mechanism remains inclusive.
